name: Curtain Footer Reveal
use: The site footer sits fixed behind the page; the last section scrolls up off it like a curtain, with a soft shadow and rounded bottom corners, while the footer content rises and fades in.
notes: Sitewide, no marker. Room is made by a script-owned aria-hidden spacer sized to the footer by ResizeObserver; no height/margin on Squarespace elements. Skips when the footer is taller than 85% of the screen, or when a transformed ancestor breaks position: fixed. Rounded corners need overflow: clip (Safari 16+); older browsers get square corners. Not yet verified on a live Squarespace site — real header z-index and #siteWrapper styles there are unconfirmed.
